records.subject: Kestrel vendor workshop transcript
records.author: Procurement Office <procurement@example.test>
records.summary: Lengthy procurement workshop notes with a decision recorded deep in the transcript.
records.externalSafeText: The workshop opened with introductions, attendance, budget history, service ownership, routine compliance reminders, and a review of old vendors. The group then discussed support rotations, documentation, regional coverage, ordinary maintenance, and a long list of nonbinding options. After several pages of background, the binding conclusion was recorded: Project Kestrel selected the zirconium failover appliance from Lumen Harbor, with acceptance testing owned by Priya Nair. This supersedes the earlier cobalt appliance proposal. The remaining transcript covers parking, catering, room access, and future agenda suggestions.
actionItems: Priya Nair owns Kestrel acceptance testing
